source.title: Truncated Skewb scrambles in versions of TNoodle version 0.13.4 and earlier
source.content:
A bug in TNoodle 0.13.4 and earlier resulted in 86 Skewb scrambles for official competitions that were accidentally truncated. As a result, they were not generated in a way that satisfies the requirements in [Regulation 4b3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3). Of these scrambles, 73 were for [CubingUSA Nationals 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2018/). The WRC has decided to keep these results.

As described in [the TNoodle 0.13.5 announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-13-5):

> Per the WCA Regulations, an official scramble sequence for Skewb must produce a random state ([4b3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3)) from those that require at least 7 moves ([4b3c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3c)) to solve.
> 
> In order to make it hard to distinguish scrambles with short solutions on a scramble sheet, TNoodle was designed to ensure that all generated Skewb scramble sequences are at least 11 moves (even if there is an optional solution with fewer moves). However, a thread safety bug in TNoodle before version `0.13.5` made it possible for scramble sequences to be truncated, such that:
> 
> * a truncated scramble sequence would be used if it required at least 7 moves to solve (still satisfying Regulation 4b3c), but
> * the truncation did not preserve the random scramble distribution (violating Regulation 4b3).
> 
> More details are available [at the TNoodle project on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/pull/368).
> 
> An analysis of solution lengths for historical scrambles suggests that this did not affect the distribution of states for the vast majority of past competitions. However, it did result in a significant bias of states towards shorter optimal solutions for at least one major competition ([CubingUSA Nationals 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2018)), which led to the discovery of this bug. We would like to thank Sébastien Auroux for bringing it to our attention, and Tim Reynolds for working with Jeremy Fleischman to identify and prepare a fix for TNoodle over the past weekend.

We have also verified that scrambles for other puzzles were not affected by a bug like this.

A full list of affected scrambles is available [here](https://github.com/SAuroux/wca-analysis/blob/master/results-scripts/scramble_validity_analysis/skewb_outliers_20181005.txt). In particular, the distribution of optimal solution length for Skewb scrambles at CubingUSA Nationals 2018 was as follows:

| Optimal Solution Length | Expected # of scrambles | Actual # of scrambles |
|-------------------------|-------------------------|-----------------------|
| 7 moves                 | ≈20                     | 51                    |
| 8 moves                 | ≈78                     | 84                    |
| 9 moves                 | ≈93                     | 61                    |
| 10 moves                | ≈5                      | 0                     |
| 11 moves                | ≈0                      | 0                     |

We believe that the large number of attempts for the competition caused conditions for the bug to happen with higher likelihood on the computer that was used to generate scramble sequences for CubingUSA Nationals 2018.

Although the impact on the scramble distribution is measurable, the WRC has decided to keep all Skewb results from the 86 truncated scrambles because:

1. We do not believe that this bug was known to anyone, or purposely used by any organizers, Delegates, or competitors. This bug is the responsibility of the WRC and the WST.
2. Delegates properly followed the Regulations by using the output of a current official version TNoodle without inspecting or analyzing the scrambles ahead of time, as required by [Regulation 4b1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b1).
3. The scrambles all still required at least of 7 moves for an optimal solution.
4. The affected results are not affected to the extent that the competitors received a clearly unfair advantage against future Skewb competitors.

For future incidents, please note that attempts should still be removed if their scramble sequences do not follow the Regulations because they did not come from a current official scramble program, as in the case of [an incident where an old version of TNoodle was used by accident](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/24).

translation.title: TNoodle 0.13.4 及更早版本中的 Skewb 打乱截断问题
translation.content:
TNoodle 0.13.4 及更早版本的一个漏洞，导致正式比赛的 86 个 Skewb 打乱意外被截断，生成方式不符合[规则 4b3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3)。其中 73 个用于 [CubingUSA Nationals 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2018/)。WRC 决定保留这些成绩。

[TNoodle 0.13.5 公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-13-5)说明：

> 根据 WCA 规则，Skewb 正式打乱必须从至少需要 7 步才能还原的状态（[4b3c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3c)）中产生随机状态（[4b3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b3)）。
>
> 为使打乱表上的短解打乱难以被辨认，TNoodle 将所有生成的 Skewb 打乱序列设为至少 11 步，即使存在更短的解。然而，`0.13.5` 之前的线程安全漏洞可能使打乱序列被截断：
>
> - 截断后的序列只要仍至少需要 7 步还原，就会被使用，因此仍符合 4b3c；
> - 但截断没有保留随机打乱分布，违反了 4b3。
>
> 详情见 [TNoodle 的 GitHub 项目](https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/pull/368)。
>
> 对历史打乱解长的分析表明，过去绝大多数比赛的状态分布未受影响。但至少有一场大型比赛 [CubingUSA Nationals 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2018) 的状态明显偏向较短最优解，因此发现了此漏洞。感谢 Sébastien Auroux 提醒我们注意该问题，也感谢 Tim Reynolds 与 Jeremy Fleischman 在过去的周末共同定位并准备 TNoodle 修复。

我们还确认，其他魔方的打乱未受类似漏洞影响。

受影响打乱的完整列表见[此处](https://github.com/SAuroux/wca-analysis/blob/master/results-scripts/scramble_validity_analysis/skewb_outliers_20181005.txt)。CubingUSA Nationals 2018 的 Skewb 打乱最优解长度分布如下：

| 最优解长度 | 预期打乱数 | 实际打乱数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7 步 | ≈20 | 51 |
| 8 步 | ≈78 | 84 |
| 9 步 | ≈93 | 61 |
| 10 步 | ≈5 | 0 |
| 11 步 | ≈0 | 0 |

我们认为，该比赛尝试次数很多，使生成 CubingUSA Nationals 2018 打乱所用电脑更容易出现触发漏洞的条件。

尽管打乱分布所受影响可以测量，WRC 决定保留这 86 个截断打乱对应的全部 Skewb 成绩，理由如下：
1. 我们不认为此前有人知道这个漏洞，也不认为主办方、代表或选手曾故意利用它。该漏洞由 WRC 和 WST 负责。
2. 代表正确遵守了规则，使用当时官方版本 TNoodle 的输出，且按[规则 4b1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b1)要求，没有提前检查或分析打乱。
3. 所有这些打乱的最优解仍至少需要 7 步。
4. 受影响程度尚未使选手相对于未来的 Skewb 选手获得明显不公平的优势。

对于未来事件，请注意：如果打乱不符合规则，是因为并非来自当时现行的官方打乱程序，相关尝试仍应删除，例如[意外使用旧版 TNoodle 的事件](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/24)。
